stella_boundary_and_approval_composition.measured_regression_and_correction: The first implementation of the CAUSAL_CHAIN_INSUFFICIENT and ASSUMPTION_UNRESOLVED signals pushed them into getSroiCalculationReadiness's blockingReasons array, which calculateAndPersistSroiRun uses to REFUSE TO CALCULATE a run at all. Running the existing tests/sroi-calculation.service.test.ts regression suite immediately surfaced 46 new failures — every existing test fixture lacking a theory-of-change graph could no longer calculate. This directly contradicted FIBC-020's graph_status='RECOMMENDED, NOT MANDATORY' and determinism_and_regression_sentinels.engine_semantics ('B4 must NOT alter deterministic SROI numeric engine semantics'). Corrected: both signals are computed and surfaced as visible SroiReadiness fields and buildReadinessIssues entries, but are NEVER pushed to blockingReasons/canCalculate. The mission's own instruction ('Do not touch direct approval hooks merely to enforce non-approvable... FIBIU19 later composes approval eligibility') is the governing rule this correction restores. Re-ran the full existing regression suite after the fix: zero new failures from this cause.
stella_boundary_and_approval_composition.deadweight_and_counterfactual_missing: Never wired into any hook at all — listOutcomesMissingCounterfactual and listOutcomesWithInsufficientDeadweightBasis are standalone, run-bound query functions (FIBDB-011 is snapshot-bound to a specific calculation_run_id, so these cannot meaningfully belong in the run-independent preliminary readiness gate the way the other two signals do). Neither is called from calculateAndPersistSroiRun, any approval function, or lib/pipeline/sroi-results.ts (which B4 does not touch — explicitly prohibited).
